title: Vickie M NDE 144
content:
I was in a car accident in august of 1990. My boyfriend at the time was driving and I was in the front passenger seat. We came round a corner, he wasn’t looking ahead, and we crashed into a car that had stopped to turn right. My face smashed into the dashboard and the windscreen came in on me. My seat came un-welded from the floor and my head smashed into the roof of the vehicle. I also had quite a deep injury to my leg. The next thing, I was screaming and being dragged out of the car by my boyfriend and neighbors that had come out of their houses. I then passed out on the ground, which was when I had my strange experience. I felt as though I was looking down on myself for a brief moment and then there was a real feeling of peace and calm. I was no longer scared or in pain. I remember I was in a very beautiful and vast place with stunning landscapes of trees, lakes and waterfalls, and everything was blue. There were people around me. I am not sure how many, as I didn't really see them. I could just feel their presence and the feeling of love. They knew my name and they reassured me that everything was going to be all right; particularly one man who I believe could have been my grandfather. He died before I was born so I did not know what he looked like. The next thing I know, I had come round and was back to reality. I felt a huge sense of sadness and longed to go back.
